boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Luther College
boards.description: Ten currently documented evening destinations in Decorah, selected for under-21-safe food, coffee, shopping, and activities.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Short Street
cards.subtitle: 1002 Short St, Decorah
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm service type, then plan carryout or delivery before the listed 11 p.m. close; Friday and Saturday list midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Short Street pizza option with the latest published food hours in town.
cards.evidence_claim: The Decorah location lists delivery and carryout until 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists delivery/carryout 9 a.m.–11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 9 a.m.–midnight Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Culver’s on Short Street
cards.subtitle: 904 Short St, Decorah
cards.notes: Check the daily flavor and head to the Short Street location before its published 10 p.m. close; lobby, dine-in, curbside, and drive-thru share the listed hours.
cards.short_summary: An evening food-and-dessert stop with daily service to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver’s lists its Decorah lobby, dine-in, curbside, and drive-thru as open daily from 10:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Culver's of Decorah, IA — Short St
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily lobby, dine-in, curbside, and drive-thru hours of 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Casey’s on College Drive
cards.subtitle: 401 College Dr, Decorah
cards.notes: For a later convenience-store stop, use the official page to place pickup before 9:30 p.m.; the store itself lists service until 10 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A College Drive convenience stop with pizza and snack options.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey’s lists the 401 College Drive store open 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily, with pickup through 9:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists store hours 6 a.m.–10 p.m. daily and pickup 6 a.m.–9:30 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Walmart Supercenter on Old Stage Road
cards.subtitle: 1798 Old Stage Rd, Decorah
cards.notes: Use this option for practical groceries or essentials when earlier venues have closed; the store page lists every day from 6 a.m. through 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A late-evening essentials and grocery destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart lists the Decorah Supercenter at 1798 Old Stage Road open daily from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists Monday–Sunday store hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Sugar Bowl at The Landing
cards.subtitle: 211 College Dr, Decorah
cards.notes: For an evening ice-cream outing during its stated season, go to the Landing location before 10 p.m.; the Water Street shop is listed as seasonal and closed.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal College Drive ice-cream stop open later than its downtown counterpart.
cards.evidence_claim: Sugar Bowl lists its Landing location at 211 College Drive as open daily from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Sugar Bowl at The Landing open daily 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and identifies a March 20–November 1 season.

cards.title: Don Jose on East Water Street
cards.subtitle: 201 E Water St, Decorah
cards.notes: Check the listed day before walking downtown: dinner service runs to 9 p.m. most nights and to 9:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday; Monday is closed.
cards.short_summary: A downtown dinner destination with documented 9:30 p.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Don Jose lists service until 9 p.m. Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday, and until 9:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant site lists Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday until 9 p.m.; Friday and Saturday until 9:30 p.m.; Monday closed.

cards.title: Mabe’s Pizza on Water Street
cards.subtitle: 110 E Water St, Decorah
cards.notes: Order dine-in, takeout, or delivery from the official site; Friday and Saturday hours extend to 10 p.m., while Sunday through Thursday list a 9 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza stop with 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Mabe’s lists dine-in, takeout, and delivery; it is open until 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday and until 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Sunday–Thursday 11 a.m.–9 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: King Pin Entertainment Center
cards.subtitle: 400 Heivly St, Decorah
cards.notes: Reserve a lane or check arcade availability before heading over; the venue lists lanes and arcade to 10 p.m. most open days and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A bowling-and-arcade option with the board’s latest activity hours.
cards.evidence_claim: King Pin lists lanes and arcade until 10 p.m. Sunday and Tuesday–Thursday, and until midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: King Pin Entertainment Center — Bowling Reservation
cards.access_notes: Official page lists lanes and arcade 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday and Tuesday–Thursday, and 11 a.m.–midnight Friday–Saturday; Monday is closed.

cards.title: Subway on Short Street
cards.subtitle: 809 Short St, Decorah
cards.notes: Use the official store page for pickup or delivery planning; its posted hours run to 10 p.m. every day, making it a reliable late sandwich option.
cards.short_summary: A daily 10 p.m. sandwich stop on the Short Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Subway at 809 Short Street lists store hours of 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Monday–Sunday store hours of 8 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Impact Coffee on Water Street
cards.subtitle: 101 W Water St, Decorah
cards.notes: Choose Thursday through Saturday for the later coffee-bar schedule, which runs to 9 p.m.; verify seasonal events separately and use the posted hours for timing.
cards.short_summary: A Water Street coffee stop open into the evening three days a week.
cards.evidence_claim: Impact Coffee lists coffee-bar hours until 9 p.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Thursday and Friday 6:30 a.m.–9 p.m. and Saturday 7 a.m.–9 p.m.
